tool.name: metilene
tool.description: calling differentially methylated regions from bisulfite sequencing data
tool.command: metilene_input.pl --in1 '$opt_in1' --in2 '$opt_in2' >/dev/null 2>/dev/null && metilene -M $Options.opt_M -m $Options.opt_m -d $Options.opt_d -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} #if $B: -f 2 -B '$B' #else -f 1 #end if -c $Options.opt_c #if $Options.opt_G: -G $Options.opt_G #end if #if $Options.X: -X $Options.X #end if #if $Options.Y: -Y $Options.Y #end if -v $Options.opt_v metilene_g1_g2.input > '$output_bedlike' 2>/dev/null && cut -f1-4 '$output_bedlike' > '$output_bedgraph' 2>/dev/null && metilene_output.pl -q '$output_bedlike' -p 0.05 -o ./metilene >/dev/null 2>/dev/null

param.name: B
param.label: BED file with regions of interest
param.help: If this file is given, metilene will only search for DMRs in these regions (-f 2 -B). The file has to be sorted like the methylation data. If this field is left empty, metilene searches for DMRs de-novo (-f 1).

param.name: opt_M
param.label: Maximum distance between two CpGs in a DMR

param.name: opt_G
param.label: Maximum segment length
param.help: Restricts the maximum length of the segments that are loaded into memory at once. Increase this value if metilene runs into memory problems. Leave empty to use the metilene default (-1: no limit). New option in metilene v0.2.8. -G

param.name: opt_m
param.label: Minimum number of CpGs in a DMR

param.name: opt_c
param.label: Multiple testing correction
param.help: Method used to adjust the p-values for multiple testing. New option in metilene v0.2.8. -c

param.name: X
param.label: Minimum number of replicates with data in group 1
param.help: Metilene will skip regions where fewer than this number of group 1 replicates have data. Leave empty for no filtering. -X

param.name: Y
param.label: Minimum number of replicates with data in group 2
param.help: Metilene will skip regions where fewer than this number of group 2 replicates have data. Leave empty for no filtering. -Y

tool.help:
**metilene** calls differentially methylated regions (DMRs) from bisulfite sequencing data. It compares two groups of methylation profiles with a two-dimensional statistical test that takes both the methylation level and the coverage of each CpG into account.
-----
## Inputs
- **Group 1 / Group 2**: two groups of sorted `bed`/`bedgraph` methylation profiles (e.g. treatment and control). Each group can contain any number of replicates. - **BED file with regions of interest** (optional): restricts the DMR search to the given regions (`-f 2 -B`). Without it, DMRs are searched de-novo (`-f 1`).
**Warning:** all input files have to be **sorted by chromosome and position**. Use the *Sort* (bedtools) tool on your bedgraph files beforehand if necessary.
-----
## Advanced options
| Option | Description | | --- | --- | | `-M` | Maximum distance between two neighbouring CpGs in a DMR | | `-G` | Maximum segment length; increase if metilene runs into memory problems (new in v0.2.8) | | `-m` | Minimum number of CpGs in a DMR | | `-d` | Minimum methylation difference | | `-c` | Multiple testing correction: Bonferroni (default) or Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (new in v0.2.8) | | `-v` | Minimum methylation score difference | | `-X` / `-Y` | Minimum number of group 1 / group 2 replicates that must have data in a region |
The number of threads is taken from the Galaxy job configuration (`$GALAXY_SLOTS`). Note that with more than one thread metilene does not emit the DMRs in genomic order.
-----
## Outputs
- **DMRs**: all detected DMRs with chromosome, start, end, q-value, mean methylation difference, number of CpGs, p-value (MWU), p-value (2D KS), mean methylation of group 1 and mean methylation of group 2. - **DMRs (first 4 columns)**: chromosome, start, end and q-value of all DMRs. - **Significant DMRs**: the subset of DMRs passing the `metilene_output.pl` filters (adjusted p-value < 0.05, absolute methylation difference >= 0.1, at least 10 CpGs), as a table and as a bedgraph. - **Plots**: PDF with the methylation and DMR length distributions, generated by the R script shipped with metilene.
-----
## Documentation
Up-to-date documentation is available in the [metilene manual](http://www.bioinf.uni-leipzig.de/Software/metilene/manual.pdf).
